turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Hi, this is Elena! Thanks for calling back so fast.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Hi Elena, this is Rohan at HyperSale. We help new SDRs ramp faster with realistic AI buyer practice and quote-backed scoring—does that sound relevant?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Yes, definitely relevant. I onboard four to six new SDRs each quarter by myself, and I can’t listen to every practice call, so I’d love to hear how it works.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Great, HyperSale runs realistic AI buyer roleplays and scores every call with exact quote evidence. Are you using peer roleplays today?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: We do some peer roleplays during onboarding, but they’re hard to schedule and the feedback can be inconsistent. I still end up reviewing what I can myself, and I don’t have a clear way to track whether reps are improving over time.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: HyperSale lets every SDR practise realistic buyer calls anytime, and every score cites the exact quote behind it. Could we schedule a demo next week?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: That makes sense, and yes, I’d be happy to see a demo next week. Do you have Tuesday at 2 p.m. Pacific available? I’d also love to see how reps improve over time and understand how long setup takes.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Tuesday at 2 Pacific works. I’ll send something over and cover improvement tracking and setup then.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Perfect, thanks, Rohan. I’ll look out for the invite. Great, talk soon!
